historical_record.description: Reputedly the site of the Jupiter Club, briefly run by Jelly Roll Morton and his wife; the building was put up with a basement restaurant space.
Mona's operated here between 1936 and 1938, one of the North Beach bars and restaurants the city's survey identifies as significant in San Francisco's LGBTQ history.
Mona's Barrel House occupied the basement here from 1936, becoming a draw for lesbian patrons when it began featuring male-impersonating waitresses; a designated San Francisco landmark.
The city's survey names the Purple Onion at this address among the bars, cafes, bookshops and clubs of the North Beach Beat scene, whose period of significance it sets at about 1950 to 1965.
